intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: On the sun-dappled crossroads near the Whispering Woods stands a weathered, dust-laden tavern that has seen better centuries...

intro.speaker: nyah
intro.text: Behold, Fifi! Witness our grand destiny! As supreme proprietor and senior partner, I have exercised my visionary executive authority!

intro.speaker: fifi
intro.text: E-executive authority?! Miss Nyah, please tell me you didn't touch our life savings pouch...

intro.speaker: nyah
intro.text: Touch it? I invested it! Every last sparkling copper! We now possess the sole deed to this legendary historic establishment!

intro.speaker: fifi
intro.text: L-legendary?! Miss Nyah, there are spiderwebs the size of blankets hanging from the beams, and the roof is leaking right onto the hearth!

intro.speaker: fifi
intro.text: Half the stools only have two legs! The cellar door is bolted shut with a rusted spoon, and we have zero coins left to buy flour or ale!

intro.speaker: fifi
intro.text: If hungry adventurers march through that door demanding hot stew, all we have to serve them is two chipped wooden cups and cold well water!

intro.speaker: fifi
intro.text: Y-yes, Miss Nyah... I'll get the mop.

intro.speaker: nyah
intro.text: Excellent! Chin up, ears forward, tail wagging! Today cobwebs, tomorrow the crowning jewel of the realm! Throw open the tavern doors!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Fifi! Report! Are the floorboards sufficiently dust-free to reflect my regal countenance?
banter.replyText: I've scrubbed them three times, Miss Nyah! But they're rough pine, so they mostly just reflect splinters...

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah, shouldn't we fold the napkins into fancy swans like the high-class city inns do?
banter.replyText: Swans?! Preposterous! In my tavern, we fold them into majestic stalking cats or not at all!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: I am not taking an afternoon nap. I am conducting an acoustic evaluation of this flour sack.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: If I keep polishing this tankard, I think I'll be able to see my own tail in the pewter!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: That spider in the corner has been staring at my tail for ten minutes. Evict it, Fifi!
banter.replyText: Aww, but Miss Nyah, his name is Barnaby Junior and he catches all the fruit flies!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah, someone left half a biscuit on table two... can I, um, dispose of it?
banter.replyText: By 'dispose of it', you mean scarf it down in one gulp! Go wash your hands first!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: A quiet tavern simply means the world is pausing in anticipation of my next stroke of genius.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Sweep to the left, sweep to the right... if only sweeping burned away tavern debts...

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Fifi, where is my royal ledger quill? The fluffy one with the peacock feather?
banter.replyText: Um... you batted it off the counter earlier because you said it made an insulting breeze...

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah, I think the cellar cat is actually just a very chubby raccoon.
banter.replyText: Nonsense! Any creature that lounges rent-free in my cellar is an honorary feline!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Notice the elegant tilt of my ears today. Perfect 45-degree angle. Peak managerial posture.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Table four has a slight wobble... maybe I can wedge a folded piece of parchment under it.

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Why do travelers always ask for 'room temperature' ale? The room is cold! Drink it cold!
banter.replyText: I think they just mean they don't want frost floating in the mug, Miss Nyah...

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: If a stray sunbeam falls upon the counter, it is my executive duty to inspect its warmth.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah, do you think adventurers will write songs about our cozy little tavern someday?
banter.replyText: Someday?! They should already be humming epic choruses about my unparalleled leadership!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Wah! Three tables sat down at once! Two mutton stews and four tankards of cider needed right now!
banter.replyText: Panic is unbecoming of my senior staff! Deploy trays with martial feline precision!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Look at this stampede! They hunger for my realm's hospitality! Double the tray stacks, Fifi!
banter.replyText: I only have two hands, Miss Nyah! If I stack a third tray, I'll crash into the hearth!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Order coming through! Watch your elbows, please! Hot gravy and cold ale on the move!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Move, move, move! Every second a mug sits empty is an affront to my royal treasury!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah! Table six is waving their spoons impatiently!
banter.replyText: Give them the patented Nyah dazzle! If that fails, tell them the stew is aging like fine wine!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Hear the glorious chime of coppers rolling into the till! Faster, Fifi, fill the chests!
banter.replyText: My hands are running so fast I'm practically sliding across the floorboards!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Four orders of roast chicken! Who has the chicken?! Oh goodness, don't drop the platter!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: This is not chaos, this is a symphony of commerce, and I am the maestro with the whiskers!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: A party of dwarves just ordered seven platters of sausages!
banter.replyText: Tell the kitchen to stoke the fires to volcanic temperatures! No dwarf leaves hungry!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Stand tall, Fifi! A full house is proof of our absolute tavern dominance!
banter.replyText: I'm standing as tall as I can, Miss Nyah, but this heavy tray is bending my knees!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah... the traveler by the window says his porridge has a hair in it...
banter.replyText: Preposterous slander! It is a certified strand of good luck spun from royal angora! Tell him to be grateful!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Who dared to complain about the temperature of the stew?! I will personally challenge them to single combat!
banter.replyText: Miss Nyah, please! He just asked for some pepper! Put the rolling pin down!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Oh dear... someone said the draft by the front entrance is chilly. I'll fetch an extra woolen blanket right away!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: A complaint about my pricing?! In this economy?! Do they know what top-grade salmon costs?!
banter.replyText: We don't serve salmon to patrons, Miss Nyah... that's just your personal private lunch stash...

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The merchant at booth one says his mug was chipped on the rim...
banter.replyText: It's called rustic antiquity! Tell him emperors in the First Age drank from skulls, so a chipped rim builds character!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Unsatisfied customers merely suffer from underdeveloped aesthetic sensibilities. Obviously.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Table three grumbled that the music was too loud for their strategic map meeting...
banter.replyText: If their strategy cannot withstand an epic lute solo, their adventuring party is doomed anyway!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: I apologized profusely and offered him a complimentary warm bread roll... whew, crisis averted!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Behold our latest upgrade! Every penny spent was an undeniable masterstroke of my visionary leadership!
banter.replyText: It really does look wonderful, Miss Nyah! The new tables don't wobble even a tiny bit!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Look at the new kitchen prep counter! The pots hang in neat rows and everything smells like cedar!
banter.replyText: Of course! Only the finest culinary architecture for my royal tavern staff!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: With this upgrade, our tavern's prestige ascends yet another rung on the ladder of eternity!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The new hearth bellows make the fire roar so bright! My ears are warm all the way to the tips!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Fifi, observe the luster on this new brass trim! Who approved this upgrade? I did! Bow down!
banter.replyText: I'm bowing, Miss Nyah! But also, thank you for picking such shiny handles, they're so easy to clean!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The new cellar shelving means no more crawling behind barrels to find the spiced blackberry wine!
banter.replyText: And more importantly, no more cobwebs tangling in my exquisite whiskers!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: An empire is not built in a day, but with upgrades this sharp, we'll conquer the highway by Friday!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: I can carry four tankards at once with the upgraded trays! My balance training is finally paying off!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Do you feel that, Fifi? That is the palpable aura of an establishment growing wealthier by the minute!
banter.replyText: I mostly feel the breeze from the new chimney vent, but it's very refreshing!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Every gold coin reinvested into this establishment is a direct compliment to my peerless taste.

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: THE WALLS HAVE EXPANDED! Gaze upon the boundless horizon of our burgeoning empire!
banter.replyText: Miss Nyah, my hands ache just thinking about how much more floor there is to mop now!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: A whole new wing! We can fit three more parties and even host returning adventurer guilds!
banter.replyText: Exactly! And more patrons means more tribute paid directly to the feline throne!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: More rooms, more rafters, more prime sleeping perches! This expansion was entirely my genius!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: I'll need to set out fresh lanterns in the new corridor so nobody bumps their toes in the dark!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Look at the high arched ceiling in the new hall! The acoustics will make my orders carry twice as far!
banter.replyText: Oh boy... my floppy ears are already twitching in anticipation of the volume...

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The carpentry smells like fresh sweet pine! The patrons are already peeking through the archway!
banter.replyText: Tell them entrance into the grand pavilion requires reverence and deep coin purses!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: From a dusty shack to a sprawling roadside fortress! Truly, my strategic acumen knows no mortal bounds.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: We have an upstairs now! Real stairs! No more climbing that creaky wooden ladder to check the rafters!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah! Look! That paladin left a pouch with five shining gold pieces on table one!
banter.replyText: Of course he did! He was utterly enchanted by my aloof majesty behind the counter!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: A massive tip! See, Fifi? Generosity is the natural human reaction to divine feline leadership!
banter.replyText: Actually, he said the extra gold was because I refilled his cider mug before he even asked...

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: A whole shiny gold piece just for being polite! My tail is wagging so hard it's fanning the soup!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: The gold coins jingle in the tip jar like celestial bells! More, mortals! Shower us in wealth!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah, with tips like this, we can afford the special glazed salmon you've been eyeing at the market!
banter.replyText: Did... did you hear that, Fifi?! Salmon?! You are hereby promoted to Senior Treat Officer!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Clink, clank, clink! That is the sound of patrons acknowledging our superior hospitality!
banter.replyText: I'll write it down in the ledger under 'Very Generous Customers We Must Never Forget'!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The merchant tipped an extra silver and said this was the coziest inn between here and the capital!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Good taste must be rewarded with gracious acceptance. Deposit the heavy coins into my royal coffer!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Good morning, Miss Nyah! The sun is peeking over the treetops and the kettle is already whistling!
banter.replyText: Ugh... morning has arrived far too early. Why must the sun invade my private quarters without an appointment?

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Fifi... my morning milk bowl. Warm. Not scalding, not lukewarm. Exactly 38 degrees.
banter.replyText: Already poured and waiting on your velvet coaster, Miss Nyah! Right next to your daily ledger!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Unlocking the front latch and letting in the crisp morning air! Let's make today wonderful!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: A grand proprietor does not wake up; she merely deigns to grace the world with her consciousness.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The bread delivery arrived! Warm sourdough loaves and fresh churned sweet butter!
banter.replyText: Inspect the crusts! If the baker shortchanged us by half an inch, I'll send him a strongly hissed letter!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Sweeping the doorstep clean before the morning merchant caravans pull up to the hitching post!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: I have drafted fourteen new administrative initiatives for today. Number one: nap at noon.
banter.replyText: Miss Nyah, you drafted that same initiative yesterday... and the day before that!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: The morning light hits my coat splendidly today. Prepare for a day of dazzling customer engagement.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The stars are out, Miss Nyah! Last call for the evening rush has wound down nicely.
banter.replyText: Finally! Lock the tavern doors before another pack of thirsty mercenaries wanders in!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Fifi, count the till! If we are short by even a single copper, I will interrogate every mouse in the cellar!
banter.replyText: Every copper is accounted for, Miss Nyah! In fact, we made extra on room rentals tonight!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Banking the hearth coals so the embers stay cozy until sunrise. Goodnight, warm fireplace.

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Night falls, and with it, my glorious daily reign enters its well-deserved resting phase.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: All the upstairs guest doors are quietly locked, and everyone is snoring softly.
banter.replyText: Good. If any guest snores too loud, throw a boot at their door. Royal orders.

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Fifi, bring my embroidered cushion. Not the cotton one. The silk one with golden tassels.
banter.replyText: It's already fluffed and sitting in your favorite chair by the warm chimney corner, Miss Nyah.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Dowsing the outer lanterns. The crickets in the meadow outside are playing such a peaceful song.

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Another victorious day in the chronicles of Nyah's magnificent tavern. Sleep well, my subjects.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: I'll finish drying the last pewter cup and turn down the wick... goodnight, Miss Nyah!
banter.replyText: Goodnight, Fifi. You did... acceptable today. Don't let it go to your floppy ears.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Listen to that jaunty tune! It makes my feet want to tap all across the tavern floor!
banter.replyText: Watch your balance, Fifi! A dancing maid with three full mugs of ale is an insurance catastrophe!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: The musician plays with acceptable flair, though their tempo lacks my natural feline grace.
banter.replyText: You could always go up on stage and do a cat dance, Miss Nyah!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: The whole tavern is humming along with the chorus! Such a joyful evening!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Lively music makes patrons stay longer, which makes them drink more, which enriches my coffer. A splendid loop!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Look at the dwarf at table five! Even his braided beard is swaying to the rhythm!
banter.replyText: Dwarves only sway when the ale is good and the music is loud. We have provided both!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Tell the bard to play something with more dramatic crescendo! Like the triumphant roar of a mountain lion!
banter.replyText: I think she mostly knows drinking songs and ballads about lost sheep, Miss Nyah...

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Clapping my hands between serving tables! Music makes the heaviest tray feel light as a feather!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Ah, the sweet melody of merriment, punctuated by the clinking of gold coins in the tip jar.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Miss Nyah! The adventuring party from table three returned from the crypts alive and kicking!
banter.replyText: Of course they did! They were fortified by our high-protein rations! Prepare the victory feast!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Welcome back, mighty dungeon slayers! Present your monster spoils and, more importantly, your gold coins!
banter.replyText: Miss Nyah! First let them sit down and take their heavy iron armor off!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Bringing out warm wet towels for the returning heroes! They look so exhausted but so proud!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Surviving a dark dungeon merely earns you the privilege of spending your loot at my fine establishment.

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: They said our travel rations saved them when they got trapped behind a cave-in!
banter.replyText: Hah! Nyah's Provisions save the day once again! Add a twenty percent heroism surcharge to the bill!

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Look at the size of that ruby they brought back! Fifi, offer them our top-tier suite immediately!
banter.replyText: I already aired out the master bedroom and fluffed the pillows, Miss Nyah!

banter.speaker: fifi
banter.text: Another quest completed safely! I'm so glad everyone made it back in one piece.

banter.speaker: nyah
banter.text: Heroes march into the shadows, but they always return to Nyah's warm hearth. It is the law of nature.

clover.speaker: nyah
clover.text: Welcome to my majestic domain, Clover! Kneel before your supreme tavern sovereign and memorize the eleven golden rules of feline hospitality!

clover.speaker: clover
clover.text: W-waah! Eleven rules?! Wait, are they written down somewhere? My hands are shaking so much I'm going to drop this tray!

clover.speaker: nyah
clover.text: Rule one: keep my tea warm! Rule two: do not step on my majestic tail! Rule three—

clover.speaker: fifi
clover.text: Miss Nyah, please don't overwhelm her on minute one! Clover, deep breaths... here, take this apron, I'll show you where the mugs are kept!

clover.speaker: clover
clover.text: Thank goodness for you, Miss Fifi... I thought my ears were going to spin right off!

roxie.speaker: nyah
roxie.text: Halt right there, rookie! Under my supreme command, maids report with a crisp salute and three reverent bows before touching a broom!

roxie.speaker: roxie
roxie.text: Yeah, how about 'no'? I clean tables, I carry pints, and I don't bow to anyone who takes three-hour naps on flour sacks.

roxie.speaker: nyah
roxie.text: WHAT?! Insolence! Fifi, fetch the disciplinary scratching post immediately!

roxie.speaker: fifi
roxie.text: Eep! We don't have a disciplinary post, Miss Nyah! Roxie, please, she just gets cranky before her afternoon milk saucer!

roxie.speaker: roxie
roxie.text: Fine. Just keep her hands off my apron and we won't have a problem.

pippa.speaker: nyah
pippa.text: Ahem! Bow down and tremble, recruit! You stand in the regal presence of Nyah, master strategist and—

pippa.speaker: pippa
pippa.text: EEEEEK! You have the fluffiest cat ears I have EVER seen in my entire life! Can I touch them?! Just one tiny squeeze?!

pippa.speaker: nyah
pippa.text: H-HEY! Keep your hands to yourself! Personal bubble! Fifi, restrain this hyperactive creature!

pippa.speaker: fifi
pippa.text: Miss Pippa, please! Miss Nyah's ears are strictly off-limits unless she's being bribed with glazed salmon!

pippa.speaker: pippa
pippa.text: Salmon bribes?! Noted! Oh, we are going to be best friends, I can already tell!

velvet.speaker: nyah
velvet.text: Gaze upon our magnificent enterprise, Velvet! Through my dazzling genius, this tavern shall become the legend of the century!

velvet.speaker: velvet
velvet.text: ...There's a puddle under table three, your left ear is dusted with flour, and the front welcome mat is upside down.

velvet.speaker: nyah
velvet.text: That is... that is deliberate avant-garde tavern aesthetic! Fifi, tell her it's artistic!

velvet.speaker: fifi
velvet.text: Um, actually, Miss Nyah knocked the flour bin over five minutes ago while trying to catch a moth...

velvet.speaker: velvet
velvet.text: Mmh. Hand me the rag. Clearly someone competent needs to run this floor.

marcel.speaker: nyah
marcel.text: Attention in the galley, Chef Marcel! My refined palate requires nothing less than culinary perfection on every pewter plate!

marcel.speaker: marcel
marcel.text: Hahaha! Fear not, Mademoiselle Nyah! A true maestro cooks with pure passion and operatic soul! Tonight we flambé with glory!

marcel.speaker: nyah
marcel.text: Wait, flambé?! No fire near my tail! Fifi, ensure this culinary maniac doesn't ignite the kitchen curtains!

marcel.speaker: fifi
marcel.text: Chef Marcel, your roasted garlic pastries smell incredible! Miss Nyah just worries because her whiskers are sensitive to smoke!

marcel.speaker: marcel
marcel.text: Magnifique! The pup understands true culinary art! A complimentary pastry for our devoted little maid!

garrett.speaker: nyah
garrett.text: Behold your station, Garrett! Behind this polished oak counter, you shall dispense liquid euphoria under my watchful royal gaze!

garrett.speaker: garrett
garrett.text: ...Mugs are clean. Taps are oiled. Keep out of my pouring lane and nobody gets soaked.

garrett.speaker: nyah
garrett.text: Did he just give ME orders?! In my own tavern?! Fifi, docked rations! One sausage penalty!

garrett.speaker: fifi
garrett.text: Miss Nyah, please! Garrett poured five foaming tankards in ten seconds without spilling a single drop! He's amazing!

garrett.speaker: garrett
garrett.text: ...Just doing my job. Line up the mugs, pup.

lyra.speaker: nyah
lyra.text: Musician Lyra! Your strings must echo my regal elegance! Write twelve epic ballads detailing my triumphs over the cobwebs!

lyra.speaker: lyra
lyra.text: Twelve ballads about cobwebs? Sweetheart, I play for heartbreak, glory, and wanderlust, not housecleaning.

lyra.speaker: nyah
lyra.text: Sweetheart?! Housecleaning?! That was a heroic conquest of arachnid trespassers! Sing it with high drama!

lyra.speaker: fifi
lyra.text: Miss Lyra, please play something cheerful! Adventurers tip twice as much when their boots are tapping!

lyra.speaker: lyra
lyra.text: Now that's a tune I can get behind! One jaunty reel coming up, boss-cat.

soleil.speaker: nyah
soleil.text: Welcome to center stage, Soleil! Remember that while your spins may captivate the crowd, I remain the main attraction!

soleil.speaker: soleil
soleil.text: Of course, darling! But when the silken ribbons fly, even the quietest dwarf puts down his tankard to watch!

soleil.speaker: nyah
soleil.text: Hmph! If anyone stares at you longer than they admire my counter poise, I'll challenge you to a leap contest!

soleil.speaker: fifi
soleil.text: Miss Nyah, remember last week when you leaped from the bar and landed headfirst in the laundry basket?!

soleil.speaker: soleil
soleil.text: Haha! Keep the laundry basket handy then, little pup! The show is about to begin!

offlineTemplates.nyahText: You stepped away for a mere {minutes} minutes?! Unacceptable! Though I suppose collecting {gold} gold from {customers} patrons softens the blow.
offlineTemplates.fifiText: Welcome back! In just {minutes} minutes, we served {customers} thirsty folks and collected {gold} gold! Miss Nyah checked the door every thirty seconds!

offlineTemplates.nyahText: Fifteen whole minutes without my royal supervision? Luckily, my sheer aura kept {customers} patrons orderly, yielding {gold} gold in {minutes} minutes!
offlineTemplates.fifiText: You were gone for {minutes} minutes! We took care of {customers} patrons and made {gold} gold! I had to sweep table two twice because of breadcrumbs!

offlineTemplates.nyahText: An entire hour! {minutes} minutes of me bravely guarding the cash box! {customers} customers visited and coughed up {gold} gold under my stern glare!
offlineTemplates.fifiText: An hour flew by! Over {minutes} minutes, {customers} hungry travelers arrived, and we banked {gold} gold! Miss Nyah only took three tiny catnaps!

offlineTemplates.nyahText: Three hours?! {minutes} minutes of endless clattering tankards! But behold: {customers} patrons parted with {gold} gold for my treasury!
offlineTemplates.fifiText: Goodness, {minutes} minutes! {customers} guests kept us running, and we earned {gold} gold! My tail hasn't stopped wagging since the afternoon rush!

offlineTemplates.nyahText: {minutes} minutes away! Six whole hours! Did you forget who runs this realm? At least {customers} generous patrons contributed {gold} gold to my greatness!
offlineTemplates.fifiText: Six hours! In {minutes} minutes, we tended to {customers} adventurers and counted {gold} gold! The cellar was practically cleaned out of cider barrels!

offlineTemplates.nyahText: A full eight-hour shift of {minutes} minutes! I worked to the bone overseeing {customers} travelers who surrendered {gold} gold! Where is my celebratory salmon platter?!
offlineTemplates.fifiText: You're back! After {minutes} minutes and {customers} lovely customers, the ledger shows an extra {gold} gold! Miss Nyah worked so hard her whiskers twitched!
